name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Balance & Weather Inversion
archetype: Water/Flying aerial starter tank, 120 Speed Ground/Fighting breaker, and Fire/Ground physical wallbreaker.
gym_duel_rationale: Koga enforces a strict 4v4 duel. Enter with Blastoise/Fearow (496 BST Water/Flying with 92 Speed and Roost recovery; completely immune to Ground moves and Toxic Spikes while destroying Bug/Poison foes with STAB Drill Peck), Dugtrio/Primeape (blazing 120 Speed Ground/Fighting sweeper with natural 100 BP Earthquake and Close Combat to demolish grounded Poison foes), Flareon/Sandslash (505 BST physical breaker with 110 Attack, Swords Dance, and Fire Fang/Lava Plume to incinerate Beedrill/Scyther), and Kadabra/Haunter (407 BST with 118 SpA, Levitate Ground immunity, and STAB Psychic to cleanly OHKO Chansey/Muk before Acid Armor can stack).

roster.progression_notes: 496 BST with 92 Speed and 90 SpD. Immune to Ground and Toxic Spikes. STAB Drill Peck hits Bug/Poison foes for super-effective damage while Roost sustains through poison damage.
439 BST speedster boasting 120 Base Speed and 95 Attack. Natural 100 BP Earthquake combined with Close Combat easily breaks grounded Poison targets.
505 BST featuring 110 Base Attack, 93 Defense, and Swords Dance boosting. Incinerates Bug/Steel targets with Fire Fang and provides Ground coverage.
407 BST with 118 Special Attack and 98 Speed. Levitate removes Ground weakness while STAB Psychic easily bypasses physical defense to dismantle Chansey/Muk.
510 BST with 91 Defense and 90 SpD. Completely absorbs incoming Grass and Water attacks, providing bulk for open-world water route traversal.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained for capturing rare Safari Zone targets with Compound Eyes boosted 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Combines Clefable's Magic Guard passive (immune to Toxic ticks, indirect damage, and hazards) with Golbat's aerial mobility.

active_fusions: Blastoise/Fearow (496 BST Water/Flying starter with 4x Drill Peck and Roost)
Dugtrio/Primeape (439 BST 120 Spe Ground/Fighting sweeper with Earthquake and Close Combat)
Flareon/Sandslash (505 BST 110 Atk Fire/Ground wallbreaker with Swords Dance)
Kadabra/Haunter (407 BST 118 SpA Levitate Psychic/Poison sweeper)
Vileplume/Poliwrath (510 BST Grass/Fighting drain bruiser with Moonlight)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Maintain current party fusions; the lineup holds ideal Ground, Psychic, and Flying counters for Koga's arena.
2. Once Linking Cords are obtained from Hotel Quests, unfuse Kadabra/Haunter at any Mart ($300) to evolve Kadabra into Alakazam and Haunter into Gengar before re-splicing.
upcoming_fusions: Blastoise/Alakazam (Endgame Special titan once Linking Cord is applied)
